Hi Tauhid,

Thanks for your order. I’m sorry, but we don’t currently have the Bulldog tee in size S available. We’re confirming whether we can restock that size, so I can’t yet promise availability or a pickup date.

We do have the same tee in sizes M, L, and XL, if you’d like to consider one of those instead. Please let us know whether you’d prefer to wait while we confirm size S or consider an available size.

Best,
Campus Customs
